name: EasyWorship
shortDescription: Church presentation software for songs, Scripture, media and service content, licensed across a campus by weekly attendance.
suitableContexts: Teams needing lyrics, Scripture and media presentation

pricing.summary: EasyWorship publishes attendance-based US-dollar campus subscriptions, with Basic and Premium starting prices and a 30-day trial.

startingPrice.qualifier: Basic starting price; attendance affects the final price

tiers.label: Basic
tiers.detail: Campus licence, core presentation software and support

tiers.label: Premium
tiers.detail: Adds a supplier media library and online media designer

pricing.trialDetails: 30 days, full access and no credit card required.

editorial.assessment: EasyWorship gives a campus-level presentation licence with price bands that follow weekly attendance. A UK church should confirm its local price, relevant Bible and media rights, devices and output requirements before choosing a plan.
bestFor: Churches wanting one campus licence for their presentation team
limitations: Content licensing must be checked for UK use

procurementVerdict.problem: Churches wanting one campus licence for their presentation team

longForm.verdict: EasyWorship is a presentation workflow choice: test whether its campus licence and content options make live-service handovers easier for volunteers.

decisionLens.heading: Attendance pricing and content rights are separate decisions.
decisionLens.text: The subscription is based on weekly attendance, while a church still needs to confirm the rights to use its chosen Bibles, songs, fonts and media in its specific setting.

sections.heading: A live-service trial
sections.question: Can ordinary operators build and run the service confidently?
paragraphs: EasyWorship publishes Basic and Premium campus subscriptions plus a thirty-day, full-access trial.
Test one real service from preparation to outputs, using the actual computer, projector, Bible versions and volunteer handover process.

userFeedback.summary: This profile uses supplier pricing and product information rather than an independent review score.
themes: Campus licensing can simplify team deployment.
The trial should test outputs and media workflow, not just slide creation.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier materials do not replace checking UK content licences and hardware compatibility.

faq.question: Does EasyWorship have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. EasyWorship advertises a thirty-day full-access trial without a credit card.

faq.question: How much does EasyWorship cost?
faq.answer: The supplier publishes Basic from $17.50/month and Premium from $27.50/month, with final price based on average weekly attendance.

faq.question: Does EasyWorship include church content licences?
faq.answer: Do not assume so. Confirm the relevant UK rights for Bibles, songs, fonts and media separately.
